title: Erich von Däniken on Templar secrets

tellings.quote:
him about the Templars and he goes there
are secrets that I cannot talk about

plain: Erich von Däniken, the Swiss author famous for arguing that ancient peoples were visited by beings from space, is said to have told the host that there are secrets about the Templars, the medieval Christian order of knights, that he cannot talk about. Michels tells this himself, as something von Däniken said to him when he asked about the order. If taken at face value, it suggests von Däniken believes he holds hidden knowledge about the Templars that he is bound to keep.
